title: [BUG] Excessive amounts of API error 529 and status.anthropic.com shows everything is working
body: ## Environment - Platform (select one): - [x] Anthropic API - [ ] AWS Bedrock - [ ] Google Vertex AI - [ ] Other: - Claude CLI version: 1.0.51 (Claude Code) - Operating System: MacOS 15.5 - Terminal: Wezterm/tmux ## Bug Description The 10 retries are omitted in the scrollback: ## Steps to Reproduce 1. Type a prompt into claude code 2. Press enter ## Expected Behavior The prompt is being executed since no outage is reported on [status.claude.ai ](https://status.anthropic.com) ## Actual Behavior HTTP request to the anthropic backend is being rejected. ## Additional Context This seems to be a reoccurring theme with anthropic just closing the tickets claiming it's not a systemic issue. We pay for a premium product, we expect premium performance. Please make status.anthropic.com into the platform for clear communications on outages that a status page is supposed to be or otherwise improve your comms (e.g. emails to customers for a heads-up).
author: lukidoescode

top_comments.body: I’m experiencing the same issue, even though I haven’t hit any usage limits  It’s frustrating to get so many 529 errors when the status page shows everything is working fine.
